title: The Six Secret Teachings — Liutao (English)
summary: A complete English reading of the Liutao, the Six Secret Teachings: six scrolls and sixty chapters ascribed to Lü Wang, the Grand Duke, and the first of the Seven Military Classics. Collated against the Song woodblock edition reproduced in the Sibu congkan and against the Siku quanshu text; the order of the chapters and two lacunae have been restored from them.
